ideas.pitch: A secure, verified peer-to-peer resource sharing and note indexing platform built exclusively for college students to bypass messy Google Drive folders.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve real problems related to college life.
ideas.title: CampusHive: Decentralized Peer-to-Peer Notes and Exam Archive
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a universal daily friction point for students across India, making judging evaluation straightforward and relatable.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent agent that predicts student attendance for hostel meals based on academic schedules and canteen preferences to minimize food waste.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve real problems related to college life.
ideas.title: MessMeter: AI-Powered Hostel Mess Menu & Food Waste Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a practical campus-level problem with clear economic and social impact metrics.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent and automation tool designed for college professors to check student assignment submissions for both traditional plagiarism and unallowed LLM generation.
ideas.problem_statement: Build AI agents, automation tools, or LLM-based applications.
ideas.title: ProctorGuard: Lightweight LLM-Driven Code Plagiarism & AI-Assist Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the hot AI track with a practical utility tool that faculty evaluators instantly recognize as valuable.

ideas.pitch: A specialized voice-enabled AI agent that conducts technical viva-voce mock examinations for engineering students in regional languages.
ideas.problem_statement: Build AI agents, automation tools, or LLM-based applications.
ideas.title: VivaPrep: Multilingual Mock Viva Voice Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies cutting-edge multimodal and speech-to-text LLM workflows to a high-stress academic scenario.

ideas.pitch: An open innovation platform that uses semantic embeddings to parse developer portfolios and automatically form balanced, multi-college hackathon teams.
ideas.problem_statement: Create any bold and innovative solution.
ideas.title: SkillSync: Autonomous Inter-College Project Matchmaker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the exact demographic of the hackathon—student developers looking for teammates—with a self-referential utility.
